<?php
/**
 * SecureMessageProtocol - Binary message framing with authenticated encryption
 * Used for inter-service communication in microservice architecture
 */
class SecureMessageProtocol {
    private string $sharedKey;
    private int $maxMessageSize;
    private int $headerSize = 12; // 4 bytes magic + 4 bytes length + 4 bytes flags

    const MAGIC_BYTES = "\x53\x4D\x50\x31"; // SMP1
    const FLAG_ENCRYPTED = 0x01;
    const FLAG_COMPRESSED = 0x02;
    const FLAG_CHUNKED = 0x04;

    public function __construct(string $sharedKey, int $maxMessageSize = 67108864) {
        if (strlen($sharedKey) < 32) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Key must be at least 32 bytes');
        }
        $this->sharedKey = $sharedKey;
        $this->maxMessageSize = $maxMessageSize;
    }

    /**
     * Derive a domain-separated subkey from the shared key using HKDF.
     * This ensures the HMAC key and the encryption key are cryptographically
     * independent (key separation).
     */
    private function deriveKey(string $info): string {
        return hash_hkdf('sha256', $this->sharedKey, 32, $info);
    }

    /**
     * Compute HMAC over the header + payload for integrity verification
     * Authenticates the ENTIRE payload regardless of length field
     */
    private function computeIntegrityTag(string $header, string $payload, string $nonce): string {
        // Authenticate header + complete payload
        $authenticatedData = $header . $payload;
        $macKey = $this->deriveKey('SMP1-integrity-mac');
        return hash_hmac('sha256', $nonce . $authenticatedData, $macKey, true);
    }

    /**
     * Calculate the total frame size for length field encoding
     * The length field represents: payload_size + tag_size + nonce_size
     * This allows the receiver to know how much data to read from the stream
     */
    private function calculateFrameLength(int $payloadSize, int $tagSize, int $nonceSize): int {
        // Frame length includes all components after the header
        $totalLength = $payloadSize + $tagSize + $nonceSize;

        // Validate that frame length fits in 32-bit unsigned integer
        if ($totalLength > 0xFFFFFFFF || $totalLength < 0) {
            throw new \OverflowException('Frame length exceeds 32-bit limit');
        }

        return $totalLength;
    }

    /**
     * Pack the frame length into the binary header
     * Uses network byte order (big-endian) unsigned 32-bit integer
     */
    private function packFrameLength(int $frameLength): string {
        // Validate before packing to prevent silent truncation
        if ($frameLength > 0xFFFFFFFF || $frameLength < 0) {
            throw new \OverflowException('Frame length overflow');
        }
        return pack('N', $frameLength);
    }

    /**
     * Encode a message into the binary protocol format
     */
    public function encode(string $message, int $flags = self::FLAG_ENCRYPTED): string {
        if (strlen($message) > $this->maxMessageSize) {
            throw new \OverflowException('Message exceeds maximum size');
        }

        $nonce = random_bytes(12);

        if ($flags & self::FLAG_ENCRYPTED) {
            $payload = $this->encryptPayload($message, $nonce);
        } else {
            $payload = $message;
        }

        $tagSize = 32; // HMAC-SHA256
        $nonceSize = strlen($nonce);
        $payloadSize = strlen($payload);

        $frameLength = $this->calculateFrameLength($payloadSize, $tagSize, $nonceSize);

        // Build header: magic + length + flags
        $header = self::MAGIC_BYTES . $this->packFrameLength($frameLength) . pack('N', $flags);

        // Compute integrity tag over header and payload
        $tag = $this->computeIntegrityTag($header, $payload, $nonce);

        // Final frame: header + nonce + payload + tag
        return $header . $nonce . $payload . $tag;
    }

    /**
     * Decode and verify a message from the binary protocol format
     */
    public function decode(string $frame): string {
        if (strlen($frame) < $this->headerSize + 12 + 32) {
            throw new \UnderflowException('Frame too short');
        }

        // Parse header
        $magic = substr($frame, 0, 4);
        if ($magic !== self::MAGIC_BYTES) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Invalid magic bytes');
        }

        $header = substr($frame, 0, $this->headerSize);
        $flags = unpack('N', substr($header, 8, 4))[1];

        // Extract nonce (12 bytes after header)
        $nonce = substr($frame, $this->headerSize, 12);

        // Extract payload and tag
        $payloadAndTag = substr($frame, $this->headerSize + 12);
        $tag = substr($payloadAndTag, -32);
        $payload = substr($payloadAndTag, 0, -32);

        // Verify integrity
        $expectedTag = $this->computeIntegrityTag($header, $payload, $nonce);

        if (!hash_equals($expectedTag, $tag)) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Integrity verification failed');
        }

        if ($flags & self::FLAG_ENCRYPTED) {
            return $this->decryptPayload($payload, $nonce);
        }

        return $payload;
    }

    /**
     * Encrypt payload using AES-256-GCM
     */
    private function encryptPayload(string $plaintext, string $nonce): string {
        $key = $this->deriveKey('SMP1-encryption-aes256gcm');
        $ciphertext = openssl_encrypt(
            $plaintext,
            'aes-256-gcm',
            $key,
            OPENSSL_RAW_DATA,
            $nonce,
            $gcmTag,
            '',
            16
        );
        if ($ciphertext === false) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Encryption failed');
        }
        return $ciphertext . $gcmTag;
    }

    /**
     * Decrypt payload using AES-256-GCM
     */
    private function decryptPayload(string $payload, string $nonce): string {
        $key = $this->deriveKey('SMP1-encryption-aes256gcm');
        $gcmTag = substr($payload, -16);
        $ciphertext = substr($payload, 0, -16);

        $plaintext = openssl_decrypt(
            $ciphertext,
            'aes-256-gcm',
            $key,
            OPENSSL_RAW_DATA,
            $nonce,
            $gcmTag
        );
        if ($plaintext === false) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Decryption failed - authentication error');
        }
        return $plaintext;
    }

    /**
     * Multi-chunk message assembly for streaming protocol
     * Validates each chunk independently before assembly
     */
    public function decodeChunked(array $chunks): string {
        $assembled = '';
        foreach ($chunks as $chunk) {
            $decoded = $this->decode($chunk);
            $assembled .= $decoded;
        }
        return $assembled;
    }
}

/**
 * ChunkedMessageBuilder - splits large messages into protocol chunks
 * Handles the case where messages exceed single-frame capacity
 */
class ChunkedMessageBuilder {
    private SecureMessageProtocol $protocol;
    private int $chunkSize;

    public function __construct(SecureMessageProtocol $protocol, int $chunkSize = 16777216) {
        $this->protocol = $protocol;
        // chunkSize of 16MB - safe well within 32-bit frame limits
        $this->chunkSize = $chunkSize;
    }

    /**
     * Build chunked frames from a large message
     * Each chunk is independently authenticated
     */
    public function buildChunks(string $message): array {
        $chunks = [];
        $offset = 0;
        $remaining = strlen($message);

        while ($remaining > 0) {
            $size = min($remaining, $this->chunkSize);
            $chunk = substr($message, $offset, $size);
            $chunks[] = $this->protocol->encode($chunk, 
                SecureMessageProtocol::FLAG_ENCRYPTED | SecureMessageProtocol::FLAG_CHUNKED);
            $offset += $size;
            $remaining -= $size;
        }

        return $chunks;
    }
}
